mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 3% indicates tighter labor markets, raising inflation expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses above 3% threshold, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Declining FEDFUNDS coupled with rising GDPC1 (demand) creates a dual signal of monetary easing and robust demand growth, prompting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing coupled with robust demand growth
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both proxies move in predicted directions, or IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Both INDPRO (supply) and HOUST (demand) rising in late-cycle expansion phases signal balanced growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST rise > 2% and 5% respectively in a month
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive in late-cycle periods when both proxies rise as specified, or IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Falling FEDFUNDS paired with rising RSAFS (demand) reflects monetary easing enabling demand expansion, driving positive returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when both move in expected directions, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS surpassing 150,000 indicates labor market expansion, boosting confidence and S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when PAYEMS crosses threshold, or IC <0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Falling UNRATE below 2% and rising FEDFUNDS above 5% mark post-shock recovery, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 2% and FEDFUNDS rises above 5%
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive in post-shock periods when both proxies move as specified, or IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in INDPRO (supply) signals stronger production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive during periods of sustained INDPRO growth, or IC <0.03 over 3-year window.
